## Purpose 
<!--- One sentence to describe the purpose of this PR, refer to any linked issues:
#14 -- this will link to issue 14
Closes #2 -- this will automatically close issue 2 on PR merge
-->
This PR moves `ClimaCore.Utilities.UnrolledFunctions` into `UnrolledUtilities.jl`. The definitions of generated functions copied over from `Unrolled.jl` have been simplified and generalized to multiple input arguments, while the rest is mostly unchanged.

This also adds a thorough set of unit tests for the unrolled functions, which includes a comparison of performance and compilation between `UnrolledUtilities` and corresponding functions from `Base` and `Base.Iterators`. The comparison results are currently printed as a table in CI; I will move these into a docs page in a follow-up PR.
